info.name: First run wizard
info.description: This application enables a pop-up window when a user first logs into owncloud.online. This window welcomes new users to owncloud.online, and contains links to the standard owncloud.online desktop client, Android app, and the iOS app. The window also shows a link for accessing owncloud.online via WebDAV. At any time, the first run wizard button can be opened again via the link on the personal page. The First run wizard can be customized to meet specific design goals, or to change links and messages. Create an appropriate theme following the Theming documentation, and changes to the look and feel of this Wizard are simple. More information is available in the First run wizard documentation, as well as the theming documentation. This is a PHP 8.4 fork maintained by BW-Tech GmbH for owncloud.online.
info.author: Frank Karlitschek, Jan-Christoph Borchardt, Tom Needham, modified by BW-Tech GmbH
